title: Service Income Apportionment
issuer: City of Seattle, Office of City Finance

passages.question: How is a job that straddles the Seattle city line divided?
passages.excerpt: Businesses that report revenue under the classification of "Service and Other Business Activities" on their City of Seattle business tax return will calculate apportionment of this revenue. ... If your business does not have income to report under the classification of "Service and Other Business Activities," you will not calculate apportionment.
